title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Approved readiness criteria, evidence and current process reference.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Review evidence against each supplied readiness criterion. Report supported/partial/missing, source and corrective action. Do not invent a score rubric, assume the source workflow is live or submit any request. Distinguish readiness, leadership approval and signed commercial prerequisites.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Evidence matrix; missing gates; proposed owners/dates; no approval action.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: Only authorized account owners use the live process and approvals.
